abstract:
The purpose of this study is to find out whether the study drug, LY4052031, is safe, tolerable and effective in participants with advanced, or metastatic solid tumors including urothelial cancer. The study is conducted in two parts - phase Ia (dose-escalation, dose-optimization) and phase Ib (dose-expansion). The study will last up to approximately 4 years.

This is a Phase 1a/1b multicenter, open-label study in participants with advanced or metastatic solid tumor malignancies known to express Nectin 4. This study evaluates an antibody-drug conjugate that binds to the protein nectin-4, which is expressed on certain cancer cells, delivering the drug to the cancer. This study is comprised of two phases: Dose Escalation and Dose Optimization (1a), and Dose expansion (1b). Phase 1a will assess the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of LY4052031 to determine the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D)/optimal dose. Phase 1b will evaluate efficacy and safety of LY4052031 as monotherapy or in combination with pembrolizumab at the RP2D/optimal dose in expansion cohorts based on tumor type and/or treatment history.
key_points_ko: 넥틴-4를 표적하는 신약 항체-약물 접합체 LY4052031의 안전성 및 권장 용량을 평가하는 1상 연구입니다.
췌장암을 포함한 진행성·전이성 고형암 환자 총 460명을 대상으로 단독 및 pembrolizumab 병용 효과를 검증합니다.
환자에게 적합한 기존 표준 치료를 모두 마쳤거나 사용 가능한 표준 치료가 없는 환자가 대상입니다.
summary_ko: 넥틴-4(Nectin-4) 단백질을 표적으로 하는 새로운 항체-약물 접합체(ADC)인 LY4052031의 안전성과 예비 효과를 확인하기 위한 1상 임상시험입니다. 췌장암을 비롯하여 기존 표준 치료를 모두 받았거나 대안이 없는 진행성 및 전이성 고형암 환자를 대상으로 합니다. 연구는 약물의 적정 용량을 탐색하는 1a상과 효과를 확인하는 1b상 확장 코호트로 나누어 진행됩니다. 1b상에서는 LY4052031 단독요법 또는 면역항암제 pembrolizumab(펨브롤리주맙)과의 병용요법을 평가합니다.
title: A Study of LY4052031 in Participants With Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Cancer or Other Solid Tumors

trial.eligibility_ko:
선정 기준:
* 췌장암 등 임상시험에서 지정한 진행성 또는 전이성 고형암 환자
* 주치의 판단하에 적합한 표준 전신 치료를 모두 받았거나, 해당 질환에 사용 가능한 표준 치료가 없는 환자 (이전 치료 횟수 제한 없음)
* ECOG 수행능력 점수가 0점 또는 1점인 환자
* RECIST 1.1 기준 측정 가능한 병변이 있는 환자 (용량 증량 코호트 A1의 경우 측정 불가능 병변도 허용 가능)
* 종양 조직 검체 제출이 가능하거나 시험 진입 전 조직 생검이 가능한 환자

제외 기준:
* 조절되지 않거나 의심되는 중추신경계(뇌) 전이 환자
* 조절되지 않는 고칼슘혈증 또는 조절되지 않는 당뇨병 환자
* 각막병증, 각막염 활동성 증거가 있거나 각막 이식 병력이 있는 환자
* 심각한 심혈관 질환 또는 최근 혈전색전증, 임상적으로 유의한 출혈 질환이 있는 환자
* 간질성 폐질환 또는 폐렴 병력이 있는 환자
* 이전에 enfortumab vedotin 치료 중단으로 이어진 3등급 이상의 피부 독성 병력이 있는 환자
trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have one of the following solid tumor cancers:

  * Cohort A1: urothelial carcinoma, triple negative breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, esophageal cancer, pancreatic cancer, ovarian cancer, cervical cancer (squamous cell carcinoma), head and neck squamous cell carcinoma or prostate cancer
  * Cohort A2/B/D: urothelial carcinoma
  * Cohort C: triple negative breast cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, ovarian cancer, cervical cancer, HNSCC (head and neck squamous cell carcinoma), esophageal cancer, pancreatic cancer, or prostate cancer
* Prior Systemic Therapy Criteria:

  * Cohort A1/C: Individual has received all standard therapies for which the participant was deemed to be an appropriate candidate by the treating investigator; OR there is no standard therapy available for the disease. There is no restriction on number of prior therapies
  * Cohort A2/B1/B2: Individual must have received at least one prior regimen in the advanced or metastatic setting. There is no restriction on number of prior therapies.
  * Cohort D: Treatment-naive for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer.
* Prior enfortumab vedotin specific requirements:

  * Cohorts A1/A2/C/D: prior treatment with enfortumab vedotin is allowed, but not required
  * Cohort B1: individual must be enfortumab vedotin naive in the advanced/metastatic setting
  * Cohort B2: individual must have received enfortumab vedotin in the metastatic/advanced setting.
* Measurability of disease

  * Cohort A1: measurable or non-measurable disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors v1.1 (RECIST 1.1)
  * Measurable disease is required as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors v1.1 (RECIST v1.1) for all Cohorts. Cohort A1 may permit non-measurable disease as defined by RECIST v1.1
* Have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1
* Have adequate archival tumor tissue sample available or undergo a screening biopsy if allowed per country specific regulations

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individual with known or suspected uncontrolled CNS metastases
* Individual with uncontrolled hypercalcemia
* Individual with uncontrolled diabetes
* Individual with evidence of corneal keratopathy or keratitis, and history of corneal transplant
* Any serious unresolved toxicities from prior therapy
* Significant cardiovascular disease
* Recent thromboembolic event and/or clinically significant bleeding disorder
* Prolongation of QT interval corrected for heart rate using Fridericia's formula (QTcF) ≥ 470 ms
* History of pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease
* History of Grade ≥3 skin toxicity associated with enfortumab vedotin that required treatment discontinuation
* Individuals who are pregnant, breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed during study or within 30 days of last dose of study intervention
